# Figure 
## Code
```{r,message=F,error=F,warning=F,fig.width=15,fig.height=7.5} 
create_MIC_histogram <- function(phenotype_cont, phenotype_log, phenotype_cat = NULL, phenotype_name) {
  # Combine log and cat data safely
  data <- tibble(phenotype_log = phenotype_log, phenotype_cat = phenotype_cat,phenotype_cont = phenotype_cont) %>% subset(phenotype_cat != "ERROR")
  
  # Create renaming vector to map log values to continuous (for better axis labels)
  renaming_vector <- unique(phenotype_cont) %>% subset(is.na(.)==F)
  names(renaming_vector) <- unique(phenotype_log) %>% subset(is.na(.)==F) %>% as.numeric
  phenotype_name <-  recode_resistance_variables(paste0(phenotype_name,"_dich_num"))
  
  x_axis_name <- ifelse(phenotype_name =="Cefiderocol", "Cefiderocol zone of inhibition (mm)",paste0(phenotype_name, " (µg/mL)"))
  
  # Plot
  if(phenotype_name == "Cefiderocol"){
    
  histogram <- ggplot(data, aes(x = phenotype_cont,fill=phenotype_cat)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 33)  +
    ylab("Isolates") +
    xlab(x_axis_name)  + theme_bw_me + resistance_cat_scale+ theme(axis.text = element_text(size=7),axis.title = element_text(size=10))
    
  } else {
  histogram <- ggplot(data, aes(x = phenotype_log,fill=phenotype_cat)) +
    geom_bar()  +
    ylab("Isolates") +
    xlab(x_axis_name) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=as.numeric(names(renaming_vector)), labels=renaming_vector)  + theme_bw_me + resistance_cat_scale + theme(axis.text = element_text(size=7),axis.title = element_text(size=10))
  }
  return(histogram)
}

# Figure
MIC_variables_no_blbli <- df_202123 %>% select(paste0(MIC_variables,"_dich_num")) %>% colSums(na.rm = T) %>% sort(decreasing = T) %>% names(.) %>% gsub("_dich_num","",.) %>% subset(. != 'blbli')
 
figures <- lapply(MIC_variables_no_blbli,FUN=function(x){
  create_MIC_histogram(df_202123[[paste0(x,"_num")]],df_202123[[paste0(x,"_log_2")]],df_202123[[paste0(x,"_cat")]],phenotype_name = x) + theme(legend.position = 'none')
}) %>% `names<-`(MIC_variables_no_blbli)

fig_w_legend <-  create_MIC_histogram(df_202123[["MERO_num"]],df_202123[["MERO_log_2"]],df_202123[["MERO_cat"]],phenotype_name = "x")
fig_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(fig_w_legend)
figures[["legend"]] <- fig_legend
``` 

## Figure
```{r,message=F,error=F,warning=F,fig.width=9.75,fig.height=9.75} 
histogram_figs <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist=figures,ncol=3,labels=c(LETTERS[1:length(figures) - 1],""),label_size = 12)
histogram_figs
```

# Save figure
```{r}
ggsave(plot = histogram_figs, filename = "./figures/s_figure_8_resistance_histograms.png", width = 9.75, height = 9.75, bg = "white",dpi=900)
```
